//: Deploy-ISOLATED config for the apps/mercado-livre/functions (codebase `mercado-livre`) Cloud Functions — the ML order-import scheduler + notification processor. Contains ONLY a functions block — deliberately NO firestore/storage/emulators keys — so a deploy with this config can never push the Flutter-owned rules (CLAUDE.md critical rule #1). Separate per-channel codebase so each marketplace deploys and scales independently. The predeploy hook runs apps/mercado-livre/functions/scripts/prepare-deploy.mjs, which esbuild-bundles the function + writes a MINIMAL workspace-free package.json. The function needs FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID + admin creds in its env (+ MERCADO_LIVRE_CLIENT_SECRET from Secret Manager once the ML API calls are wired). Deploy: firebase deploy --only functions:mercado-livre --config firebase.mercado-livre.deploy.json --project <id>. See apps/mercado-livre/functions/DEPLOY.md.
